arabic text: FATIMA ZAHRA (SA), FATIMA ZAHRA (SA)\nYA ZAHRA (SA), YA ZAHRA (SA)
english translation text: O FATIMA ZAHRA (SA), O FATIMA ZAHRA (SA)\nO ZAHRA (SA), O ZAHRA (SA)

arabic text:
AEY MERI BIBI TERAY DAR PAY ISTAGHASA HAI
TERA MAMNOON MERI SHAHZADI YE JAHAN SARA HAI
YA ZAHRA (SA), YA ZAHRA (SA)
O ZAHRA (SA), O ZAHRA (SA)
english translation text: O MY LADY, I COME TO YOUR DOOR SEEKING HELP.\nMY PRINCESS, THIS WHOLE WORLD IS INDEBTED TO YOU.

arabic text:
TU HAMAIN HIFZ AUR AMAN’N DAY DAY
APNI CHADAR KA SAIBAN DAY DAY
TERI QUDRAT MEIN KYA NAHIN BIBI
TU JISAY CHAAHAY DO JAHAN DAY DAY
YA ZAHRA (SA), YA ZAHRA (SA)
O ZAHRA (SA), O ZAHRA (SA)
english translation text:
GRANT US PROTECTION AND SAFETY.
GIVE US THE SHELTER OF YOUR SACRED CLOAK.
BIBI, WHAT IS THERE THAT YOU CANNOT DO?
TO WHOM YOU WISH, YOU GRANT BOTH WORLDS.

arabic text:
TUJH KO UMMAT NAY YUN SATAYA HAI
MARG-E-MOHSIN PAY BHI RULAYA HAI
TUJH KO BABA KAY BAAD UMMAT NAY
HAAYE DARBAR MEIN BULAYA HAI
YA ZAHRA (SA), YA ZAHRA (SA)
O ZAHRA (SA), O ZAHRA (SA)
english translation text:
THE UMMAH HAS TORMENTED YOU SO SEVERELY.
EVEN AT THE DEATH OF MOHSIN, THEY MADE YOU WEEP.
AFTER YOUR FATHER, O ZAHRA,
THEY DRAGGED YOU INTO THEIR COURT.

arabic text:
GHUM YE MUJH SAY NAHIN SAHA JATA
QATL-E-MOHSIN SAY BARH KAR MUSHKIL THA
BHARAY DARBAR MEIN MERA JANA
YA ZAHRA (SA), YA ZAHRA (SA)
O ZAHRA (SA), O ZAHRA (SA)
english translation text:
BOLI ZAHRA ALI (A.S) SAY YA MAULA
ZAHRA SAID TO ALI (A.S): O MY MASTER,
I CAN NO LONGER BEAR THIS GRIEF.
MORE PAINFUL THAN THE KILLING OF MOHSIN
WAS ENTERING THAT CROWDED COURT.

arabic text:
JAB THA RASSI MAIN MURTAZA (A.S) KA GALA
IMTIHAN ZABT KA WO THA TERA
HAAN MADINA UJAR GAYA HOTA
TU HO SAY DETI BAD-DUA ZAHRA
YA ZAHRA (SA), YA ZAHRA (SA)
O ZAHRA (SA), O ZAHRA (SA)
english translation text:
WHEN A ROPE WAS TIED AROUND MURTAZA’S NECK,
THAT WAS YOUR TRIAL OF PATIENCE AND RESTRAINT.
MADINA WOULD HAVE BEEN DESTROYED ENTIRELY
IF YOU HAD UTTERED EVEN ONE CURSE, O ZAHRA.

arabic text:
TU HIJAB-E-KHUDA HAY YA ZAHRA (SA)
DARD TERAY HAIN SAB SAY POSHIDA
KITNI MUZTAR HAY KITNI ZAKHMI HAY
YA ALI (A.S) JANTAY HAIN YA FIZZA (SA)
YA ZAHRA (SA), YA ZAHRA (SA)
O ZAHRA (SA), O ZAHRA (SA)
english translation text:
YOU ARE THE DIVINE VEIL OF ALLAH, O ZAHRA.
YOUR PAINS ARE HIDDEN FROM THE WORLD.
HOW DISTRESSED AND WOUNDED YOU WERE—
ONLY ALI (A.S) KNEW, ONLY FIZZA (SA) KNEW.

arabic text:
AEY MOHAMMAD (SAWW) KI LAADLI DUKHTAR
GHUM MAIN TERAY HAY MURTAZA (A.S) MUZTAR
JIS NAY DHAAYA THA BAAB-E-KHAYBAR KA
GIR GAYA KHAK PER WO YE KEH KAR
YA ZAHRA (SA), YA ZAHRA (SA)
O ZAHRA (SA), O ZAHRA (SA)
english translation text:
O BELOVED DAUGHTER OF PROPHET MUHAMMAD (SAWW),
MURTAZA (A.S) IS SHAKEN BY YOUR SORROW.
THE ONE WHO TORE DOWN THE GATE OF KHAYBAR
FELL TO THE GROUND SAYING…

arabic text:
HUM KO HAR AAN YE NADAMAT HAY
HUM HAIN MUJRIM TERI ADALAT HAY
RIZQ AULAD ZINDAGI HAR PAL
JO BHI KUCH HAY TERI BADOLAT HAY
YA ZAHRA (SA), YA ZAHRA (SA)
O ZAHRA (SA), O ZAHRA (SA)
english translation text:
AT EVERY MOMENT WE FEEL REMORSE.
WE STAND GUILTY BEFORE YOUR COURT.
OUR SUSTENANCE, OUR CHILDREN, OUR EVERY BREATH—
WHATEVER WE HAVE IS THROUGH YOUR BLESSING.

arabic text:
QARZ MAKROOZ KA ADA KARDE
MUFLISON KA NASEEB WAH KARDE
JIN KI GODI NAHI BHARI BIBI
UNKO AULAD TU ATA KARDE
YA ZAHRA (SA), YA ZAHRA (SA)
O ZAHRA (SA), O ZAHRA (SA)
english translation text:
CLEAR THE DEBTS OF THOSE BURDENED.
OPEN THE DESTINY OF THE POOR.
THOSE WHOSE LAPS ARE EMPTY, O BIBI—
BLESS THEM WITH CHILDREN.

arabic text:
ANGINAT HAIN MERAY GUNAH BIBI
WASTA TUJH KO TERAY BACHON KA
BAKHSHWANA MERAY GUNAH BIBI
WAQT-E-AKHIR HAY BUS MERA BIBI
YA ZAHRA (SA), YA ZAHRA (SA)
O ZAHRA (SA), O ZAHRA (SA)
english translation text:
MY FINAL MOMENTS ARE NEAR, O BIBI.
MY SINS ARE COUNTLESS.
FOR THE SAKE OF YOUR CHILDREN—
HAVE MY SINS FORGIVEN.

arabic text:
FARSH-E-MAJLIS PAY AUR MUSALLAY PER
HAR JAWAN KEH RAHA HAY RO RO KAR
HUM RAHAIN NA RAHAIN MAGAR BIBI
TA QAYAMAT RAHAY GHUM-E-SARWAR
YA ZAHRA (SA), YA ZAHRA (SA)
O ZAHRA (SA), O ZAHRA (SA)
english translation text:
ON THE MAJLIS FLOOR AND EVERY PRAYER MAT,
EVERY YOUTH CRIES IN TEARS:
WHETHER WE LIVE OR NOT, O BIBI—
MAY THE SORROW OF YOUR MASTER REMAIN UNTIL QIYAMAT.

arabic text:
AEY MERI BIBI TERAY BACHON KA GHUM MANTAY HAIN
APNI AULAD SAY KAHIN BAAT KAR GHUM YE PYARA HAY
YA ZAHRA (SA), YA ZAHRA (SA)
O ZAHRA (SA), O ZAHRA (SA)
english translation text: O MY LADY, WE ACCEPT THE SORROW OF YOUR CHILDREN.\nSPEAK TO YOUR CHILDREN—THIS GRIEF IS BELOVED TO US.

arabic text: GHARQ-E-MATAM SHUD ALAM-E-BALA\nMIRAWAD MAULA SARWAR-E-ZAHRA\nAAH-O-WA-WAILA AAH-O-WA-WAILA
english translation text: THE ATMOSPHERE IS IMMERSED IN MOURNING, THE STANDARD RAISED HIGH.\nTHE MASTER, THE BELOVED OF ZAHRA, PROCEEDS FORWARD.\nALAS… WOE… LAMENTATION UPON LAMENTATION.
